mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 1.0% consistently compresses equity discount rates by reducing the risk-free rate, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of other macro conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 1.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.5 percentage point monthly increase in unemployment rate above 6.0% signals imminent economic contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate collapsing household demand, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 105.0 (INDPRO) during manufacturing slowdowns indicates supply chain bottlenecks that reduce corporate margins, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of INDPRO < 105.0 periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% annually signals persistent price pressures that force aggressive Fed tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0 periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Nonfarm payrolls above 136 million (PAYEMS) consistently reflect strong labor market conditions that support corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of PAYEMS > 136 million periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 850 thousand units (HOUST) during expansionary cycles boost consumer confidence and retail spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of HOUST > 850 periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and payrolls (PAYEMS) signal synchronized supply-demand shocks that depress earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO and PAYEMS both decline, or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.
